other_conditions: Must be a recognized state sports association registered under the Jharkhand State Registration Department.
Must be affiliated with the Jharkhand Olympic Association and the relevant National Sports Federation.
Must have district-level units functioning in at least 18 districts of the state (or at least 15 districts for sports other than Olympics/Asian/Commonwealth Games).
Para‑sports associations and those related to Olympic, Asian Games, or Commonwealth Games are eligible.
Associations receiving central government grants for the same project cannot apply for state grants.
Must have a functional independent website.
Must have a PAN card and a nationalized bank account.
Must submit the audit report of the last three years.
benefits_summary: Provides financial grants to recognized state‑level sports associations for organizing competitions, training camps, and administrative support.
